newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt storage firm ups Q3 96/7 profits.
newsitem.headline: Egypt storage firm ups Q3 96/7 profits.

text.p: General Silos and Storage said it raised net pre-tax profits for the first nine months of financial 1996/7 to 57 million pounds ($16.8 million) from 44 million in the same period of the previous year.
The firm, partially privatised in November, said in an advertisement it had opened a 50,000-tonne storage space in April and was expanding handling facilities in Damietta and Dikheilah.
General Silos and Storage shares were privatised at 39.00 pounds and were trading on Sunday at about 97 pounds.
